The Hills Of Kaitoke

By Catherine Fraser.. This should be played like a slow reel..
Named after the beautiful Rimutaka Ranges that surround YMCA Camp Kaitoke, New Zealand, where the annual Southern Hemisphere International School of Scottish Fiddle is held
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sSjj7pSljro
Lovely Tune.. Makes me smile when I hear it..

↳ Posted by MarcusDisessa on September 29th, 2015.

The Hills Of Kaitoke, X:6

This is how I hear the chords for this lovely tune, as heard here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rCgy4XDjVhs&list=RDrCgy4XDjVhs&start_radio=1
I’d probably play these on the guitar with the top two strings open, and my A would be Asus2 (x02200) or Aadd9 (x07600), F#m would be F#m11 (2x2200) and B would be Bsus4 (x24400).
The chordal run up in the second part has a 3-3-3-3-2-2 rhythm - the B in that run up might be E/B.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on November 2nd, 2025.
